models_evaluated: Google Cloud Vertex AI AutoML Vision pneumothorax model (cloud and edge)

links.outcome: AI sensitivity versus physicians of varying experience for minimal pneumothorax detection on same radiographs
links.effect: AI sensitivity 0.93 (95% CI: 0.79, 0.97) versus 0.55 (95% CI: 0.38, 0.69) to 0.84 (95% CI: 0.69, 0.92) among human readers; outperformed junior clinicians and matched or exceeded seniors.
links.quote: The model outperformed junior clinicians and matched or exceeded senior physicians, particularly in detecting minimal pneumothoraces, where AI sensitivity reached 0.93 (95% CI: 0.79, 0.97) compared to 0.55 (95% CI: 0.38, 0.69) - 0.84 (95% CI: 0.69, 0.92) among human readers.

unlisted_practices: Edge versus cloud deployment performance comparison of imaging AI

screen.reason: Retrospective reader study evaluating the diagnostic performance of an AI model for pneumothorax detection compared to 15 physicians across cloud and edge deployment environments, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
